/* Processes the ULuxTraceComponent virtual tick at a fixed 60 Hz step.
   
   Algorithm:
   1. Ignore the caller-supplied DeltaTime and load the global 1/60-second constant.
   2. Run ULuxTraceComponent_TickComponent, which advances lifetime/material and spline/interpolator
   state.
   3. Reload the same fixed step and tail-call the inherited component tick with the original
   TickType and tick-function pointer.
   
   Parameters:
     pTraceComponent: exact 0x4B0 trace component.
     flDeltaTimeIgnored: Unreal tick delta; deliberately replaced by the fixed 1/60-second value.
     dwTickType: original ELevelTick value forwarded to the inherited tick.
     pThisTickFunction: original FActorComponentTickFunction pointer forwarded to the inherited
   tick.
   
   Returns:
     void.
   
   Caller/Order:
     The only references are vtable/data entries at 0x1448E4C18 and 0x143360FA8; there is no direct
   native SimulationLoop caller. Unreal virtual component ticking enters this wrapper. Trace state
   advances before the inherited tick tail call.
   
   Concurrency/Reentrancy:
     This wrapper contains no reentrancy or duplicate-call guard. Its child routes may enqueue work,
   but they busy-wait for completion and converge before returning.
   
   Rollback Relevance:
     Direct native SimulationLoop resimulation does not, by itself, prove this Unreal component tick
   ran. Any manual rollback invocation must preserve this exact fixed-step order and must suppress
   or account for the corresponding outer Unreal tick so a logical frame is neither skipped nor
   ticked twice.
   
   Source:
     SoulcaliburVI.exe 0x1408D8BF0. */

void ProcessLuxTraceComponentFixedStepTick
               (ULuxTraceComponent_RollbackPartial *pTraceComponent,float flDeltaTimeIgnored,
               uint dwTickType,FActorComponentTickFunction_Partial *pThisTickFunction)

{
                    /* Advance retained trace state first at a fixed 1/60-second step. */
  ULuxTraceComponent_TickComponent(pTraceComponent,g_flFramesToSeconds60Hz);
                    /* Tail-call the inherited component tick with the same fixed step and original
                       tick context. */
  UActorComponent_TickComponent
            ((UObject_Partial *)pTraceComponent,g_flFramesToSeconds60Hz,dwTickType,
             (FActorTickFunction_Partial *)pThisTickFunction);
  return;
}
